description: This file defines interfaces and classes for managing socket pools in the Chromium networking stack, including layered socket pools, socket parameters, and socket request handling.

classes.name: HigherLayeredPool
classes.description: Interface for higher layer socket pools to communicate with lower layer pools.

classes.name: LowerLayeredPool
classes.description: Interface for layered socket pools to communicate with each other.

classes.name: ClientSocketPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of sockets, including idle sockets and socket requests, with layered architecture support.

classes.name: ClientSocketPool::GroupId
classes.description: Identifies a group of socket requests sharing destination, privacy, and DNS policies.

classes.name: ClientSocketPool::SocketParams
classes.description: Parameters used to create socket connections, including SSL configurations.

methods.name: RequestSocket
methods.description: Requests a connected socket for a specified group, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: RequestSockets
methods.description: Requests multiple sockets for a group to ensure availability.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of a pending socket request.

methods.name: ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases a socket back to the pool, adding it to idle sockets if still connected.

methods.name: FlushWithError
methods.description: Clears all socket pool state, failing pending requests.

methods.name: CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: Closes idle sockets within a specific group.

methods.name: IdleSocketCount
methods.description: Returns total number of idle sockets.

methods.name: IdleSocketCountInGroup
methods.description: Returns number of idle sockets in a specific group.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Gets the load state of a socket handle.

methods.name: GetInfoAsValue
methods.description: Returns current pool state as a value for diagnostics.

methods.name: HasActiveSocket
methods.description: Checks if there is an active or connecting socket for a group.
